title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Maine Black Bears and Lafayette Leopards, originally scheduled for Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 4:30 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Maine Black Bears win, the market will resolve to "Maine Black Bears".
If the Lafayette Leopards win, the market will resolve to "Lafayette Leopards".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Monday, November 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
